basics.name: Samvel Movsisyan
basics.label: Full-Stack Software Engineer
basics.summary: 6+ years of commercial experience building web and mobile applications: SaaS platforms, reusable UI components, REST API integrations and maintainable architectures, with AI-assisted workflows that keep quality and security high. I use AI-assisted development to move faster while keeping code quality, security and architecture consistent. I care about state management, performance and working closely across frontend and backend teams.

work.name: AmeriPharma
highlights: Built and scaled Medbox, a cross-platform mobile app (iOS & Android) and web portal for medication tracking and appointment scheduling, using React, React Native and TypeScript.
Developed secure backend services and REST APIs with Node.js and Express, with role-based authentication and robust error handling.
Engineered reusable UI component systems and optimised client-side state management, making the app noticeably more responsive and stable.
Managed end-to-end mobile releases on the Apple App Store and Google Play Console, from CI/CD build configuration to production deployment.
Partnered with cross-functional teams to deliver HIPAA-compliant, production-ready healthcare features in Agile workflows.

work.name: staff.am
highlights: Architected and developed RESTful APIs with Node.js and Express.js, connecting scalable backend services with React frontends and relational databases.
Optimised candidate-facing web performance through code-splitting, lazy loading, component memoisation and efficient data fetching.
Improved reliability with automated unit and integration tests in Jest and React Testing Library for core user workflows.
Streamlined local development and deployment by containerising services with Docker and tuning Webpack and Babel builds.
Expanded the platform to iOS and Android with React Native, reusing core business logic, state management and backend integrations.

work.name: Hirebee.ai
highlights: Architected reusable React.js and Next.js component libraries and shared UI patterns, speeding up frontend delivery across teams.
Engineered a robust client-side state architecture with Redux Toolkit and Zustand for predictable data flow across complex modules.
Optimised recruiter dashboard rendering and data handling with memoisation, list virtualisation and dynamic code-splitting, significantly cutting load times.
Integrated secure REST and GraphQL endpoints and Node.js services to power automated candidate filtering and parsing.
Kept engineering quality high through rigorous code reviews, automated CI/CD checks and Agile/Scrum planning.
